An English crib of the Latin text, semi-literal, made for this database in 2026 with Claude, a large language model (LLM) made by Anthropic. It keeps close to the wording of the original and uses the established English of Anglo-Latin legal, liturgical and canon-law formulae. It is an aid to reading the original, not a published translation. div.ab: Et si redierit, quisquam eum recipere non presumat, nisi per consensum iustitie regis.

div.ab: And if he returns, let no one presume to receive him, except with the consent of the king's justice.

note.seg: Gemeint ist zunächst der Sheriff; s. d. Gl 1e. 13e. Die strengere Vorschrift in Retr ist wohl aus der Friedlosigkeit im Reiche übernommen; hier denkt Verf. nur an die Grafschaft; vgl. Gl Verbannung 9. — reditum2 fecerit Rs

Meant in the first place is the sheriff; s. Gl s.v. 1e. 13e. The stricter rule in Retr is probably taken over from outlawry throughout the realm; here the author has only the shire in mind; cf. Gl Verbannung 9. — reditum2 fecerit Rs
